title: Long-running tasks
sub: A queue of questions worked through across many sessions, each one starting on its own.

steps.h: A scheduled tick starts a new session
steps.d:
cron calls run_session() on a timer
no person opened this run

steps.h: Your code loads the checkpoint and rebuilds the context from notes, not the transcript
steps.d:
queue: 1 question left · 1 note carried from an earlier session
retrieved: dr210-manual#2, specs-comparison#1
(no earlier session's messages are replayed)

steps.h: The model reads the sources and the notes, and decides to flag rather than guess
steps.d:
→ flag_for_review(reason="specs-comparison#1 gives 208V;
dr210-manual#2 gives 240V; sources disagree")
(it could have called answer(...) instead — that branch,
left, was not taken this run)

steps.h: Your code hands the question to a person and checkpoints
steps.d:
pending["What voltage does the DR-210 need?"] = "sources disagree"
state saved to disk; no session touches this question again
until someone resolves it

steps.h: A person resolves it, on their own time, not the scheduler's
steps.d:
resolve(): "Checked the nameplate: it's 240V, 30A —
the comparison sheet was for an older model."
